_comment: Fight readability light (tech-artist 2026-11-25, Boss approved: 'the fight scene is too dark, small fighters sink into the floor'). Read by client/fight_light.gd after the stage has set its sky / night look. Each block matches a map id prefix (longest wins; 'default' otherwise). exposure = Environment.tonemap_exposure (the whole picture), ambient = multiplier on the map's ambient energy, key / rim = multipliers on the CHARACTER-ONLY key and rim lights (client/character_light.gd: they light only the fighters' render layer, so they lift units off the floor at no extra light cost). Keep each zone's identity: orc stays night-blue, only readable.
_dusk: Optional look keys (Boss 2026-11-25: the orc camp is DUSK, not night): sky = [top, middle, horizon] colours (a procedural gradient sky, kept by the drawn style), sun_color / sun_energy / sun_rotation (the stage's one existing sun: low and from one side = long shadows), ambient_color (the shadow tint), key_color / rim_color (the fighters' own lights). Colours, energies and angles only: no new lights or passes.
